nodes.title: #119 TEST — Previous Clip MP4 + Temporal Anchor
widgets_values:
验证目标：上一条已确认 Clip MP4 提供动态 AV 连续性，同时 TEMPORAL ANCHOR 在本 Clip 的指定位置提供硬视觉锚点。

数据流：ReferenceToVideo positive + latent → H3 Custom Keyframes；Temporal Anchor Image + Position → H3 Custom Keyframes；其输出 conditioning → BasicGuider。随后仍由 H3 Start Masked Context 把 Previous Clip 的 39 帧 AV context 写入 sampler latent_image。

默认测试：10s≈243帧，Temporal Anchor position=226（约9.42s），避免把锚点放在受保护的开头 context 内。

nodes.title: #120 ⚙️ CR Prompt Text（提示词）
widgets_values:
Continue directly from the final moment of the selected start clip with no cut, reset, or re-establishment.

The incoming protected audiovisual prefix is authoritative for the current pose, motion, camera trajectory, lighting, environment, object state, voice, ambience, and timing.

Continue the exact motion and sound already in progress naturally.

Preserve the existing camera trajectory, spatial continuity, environment, lighting, ambience, and audiovisual timing throughout.

The connected temporal keyframes define required visual states at their assigned temporal positions.

Develop naturally through the temporal keyframes in chronological order while preserving continuous motion and audiovisual continuity.

Do not introduce, describe, anticipate, or prematurely reveal the visual content of a future temporal keyframe before its assigned temporal position.

Do not reset the scene at a temporal keyframe. Each temporal keyframe is part of the same continuous shot and must be reached through natural continuous development from the preceding state.

No cuts, no scene reset, no camera reset, no re-establishment, and no restart from rest.
